title: What is CAP

analogy: Think of "What is CAP" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without What is CAP, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.

useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using What is CAP without core mods.
